baslik: Which action camera does AI recommend for Black Friday? GoPro isn't #1 #shorts
aciklama:
Across 64 live-search answers from 4 AIs in the US, DJI came up in 60 and was the first brand named in 40; GoPro was named first in only 13. Google Shopping flips it: in the "action camera" search, GoPro ranks 1st and DJI 12th.

Highlights
• Mentions (64 answers): DJI 60, Insta360 52, GoPro 49, Akaso 19.
• First brand named: DJI 40, GoPro 13, Insta360 10, Akaso 1.
• ChatGPT mentioned GoPro in 8 of 16 answers and never named it first; Gemini mentioned GoPro in all 16.
• Under $200, Akaso showed up in 8 of 8 answers; for 360 cameras, Insta360 in 8 of 8.
• Google Shopping (US, "action camera"): 1. GoPro, 2. Insta360, 12. DJI; 16 of the top 20 listings are Insta360, and Akaso isn't in the top 20.

Questions this video answers
• Which action camera does AI recommend? Mostly DJI, then Insta360 and GoPro.
• Do AI and Google Shopping agree? No: AI's top pick DJI sits 12th on Shopping.
• What does AI pick on a budget? Under $200, Akaso appeared in every answer.
• Where does AI look? The most cited site was tomsguide.com (14 answers).

Method: Nov 24, 2026, US, questions in English. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini answered 8 questions twice each with live web search (64 answers). Google Shopping data from the same day, US. Small sample, not representative of the whole market.

These are the AI's answers, not our recommendation. This is an independent measurement; we have no sponsorship or partnership with any brand shown.
